# Javion Fasteners — https://javionfasteners.com
> Precision industrial fastener manufacturer based in Rajkot, Gujarat, India.

## About
Javion Fasteners designs, forms, heat-treats, and finishes industrial fasteners for OEMs and industrial buyers. Products include bolts, screws, nuts, washers, and custom OEM hardware with lot traceability and ISO-aligned quality systems.

- Industries: automotive, construction, oil & gas, aerospace, electronics, marine, heavy machinery, solar / renewable energy
